name: stat-card
title: Stat card
description: KPI tile with value, trend delta and a sparkline slot.
htmlExample:
<bef-stat-card style="width:260px" label="Revenue" value="₹12.4L" :delta="8.2"><bef-bar-chart-icon slot="icon"></bef-bar-chart-icon></bef-stat-card>
<bef-stat-card style="width:260px" label="Churn" value="2.1%" :delta="-0.4" delta-label="vs last quarter"></bef-stat-card>
